headline: Putin, war leader and election campaign chief, prepares Russia for military escalation
subhead: For the first time since the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Russians will elect their MPs between September 18 and 20. Orchestrated by the Kremlin, this vote carries no real electoral stakes and serves above all as a tool to rally support for the war effort.

headline: The letters from two Ukrainian sisters: 'Stay in bed or take shelter elsewhere: a life-or-death decision'
subhead: Sasha and Olga Kurovska are two Ukrainian sisters, one lives in Kyiv, the other in Paris. Faced with Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure, Sasha admires her fellow citizens' determination to never give up, while Olga, fresh from a month-long stay in Ukraine, better understands her sister's reactions to the constant threat of bombing.

headline: Down with sexual laziness! Why sex is worth putting in the effort
subhead: Amid a growing trend of 'dating fatigue' and an increasing aversion to making an effort sexually, Le Monde's sex columnist Maïa Mazaurette explains how taking the easy way out leads nowhere when it comes to pleasure.

headline: 'China will not replace the United States as a global power'
subhead: Dan Wang, a Chinese-Canadian researcher living in the US, has devoted his latest book, 'Breakneck: China's Quest to Engineer the Future,' to the two rival powers. In an interview with Le Monde, he discussed what sets them apart, but also what brings them together.

subhead: In the second part of her documentary 'My Undesirable Friends,' the filmmaker immerses viewers in the lives of reporters forced to flee Russia abruptly, but who continue to inform their fellow citizens about the war in Ukraine in spite of the precarious conditions and ongoing intimidation.

headline: Far-right figure Bardella is uneasy about Le Pen's election platform on headscarves and pensions
subhead: In recent days, Jordan Bardella, the second-in-command of Marine Le Pen's far-right Rassemblement National party, has downplayed two of the party's most symbolic proposals and contradicted Le Pen on why one of his advisers quit.

headline: Frida Kahlo's paintings, the wealthy collector and her cunning friend spark a fight for Mexico's art
subhead: On September 8, part of the most important collection of modern Mexican art assembled by Jacques and Natasha Gelman will be exhibited in Spain. The future of this priceless collection now lies with the Spanish bank Santander. In Mexico, a collective fears that these paintings, considered national heritage, may never be displayed in their home country again.
